texts.label: caption
texts.orig: Fig. 5. Location of AFTA (Apatite Fission-Track Analysis) samples from Borborema Province; NE Brazil (sample numbers shown as 4 to 36; full sample reference number is RD57-4 to RD57-36; CE, RN, PB and PE means, respectively; Ceará, Rio Grande do Norte, Paraíba and Pernambuco States) Samples consist of igneous and metamorphic Precambrian rocks (see Table 1 for details) (1) Borborema Plateau; (2) Interior lowlands; (3) Coastal cuestas (mainly Barreiras Fm); (4) Early Cenozoic mesas (Serra do Martins Fm); (5) Cretaceous basins; (6) Early Cretaceous Tholeiitic Dike Swarm; 7) Cenozoic volcanics.
